kjv-1611.note: 1611 first-edition KJV, original spelling, one JSON per book. Body text of the corpus.

kjv-witness.note: Standard (1769-orthography) KJV, one JSON per book. Used ONLY to restore the LORD/GOD small-capital casing the 1611 transcription flattened, and to cross-check versification. No text is taken from it.

kjv-osis.note: eBible.org public-domain KJV in OSIS. Used ONLY for the 138 Psalm titles (116 superscriptions + 22 Psalm 119 letter headings), which the 1611 transcription omits.

geneva-1599.note: Geneva Bible, 1599 edition, original spelling, USFM straight from eBible.org (public domain). Verse text only; the marginal notes are not in this source. (The GitHub mirror of this text has a corrupted Genesis 38 — do not substitute it.) eBible.org is slow; allow several minutes.

kjv-gutenberg.note: Project Gutenberg #10 KJV plain text. Third casing witness (LORD/GOD) for the majority vote; contributes no text.

kjv-crosswire.note: CrossWire KJV SWORD module (v3.1, OSIS with Strong's). Casing witness: it marks the divine name explicitly (<divineName>), so its LORD/GOD vote is markup, not a transcriber's shift key. Contributes no text.

geneva-1560-meta.note: Internet Archive item metadata for the 1560 Geneva Bible first edition (identifier 1560-the-geneva-bible, CC0/public domain). Provenance anchor for the facsimile; contributes no served text.

geneva-1560-pages.note: Leaf/page index for the 1560 facsimile. Used ONLY to map a book+chapter to an approximate opening leaf; contributes no served text.

geneva-1560-ocr.note: Unreliable blackletter OCR of the 1560 facsimile. NEVER served as scripture; locked only as tamper-evident INPUT to the experimental notes-reconstruction pipeline.
